name: video_speak
description: Lip sync an image or video to a given audio. Use it only when the speech must keep an exact voice or track (an `audio_tts` voice, a cloned voice, a supplied recording) or one voice across clips. Any other talking video: `video_generate` with a native-audio model and the lines in the prompt. Image+audio → talking head (`omnihuman`). Video+audio → lip sync (`lipsync-2.0`). Omit `mode` for that auto choice; pass the slug, never the display name. Pass asset URLs or a creation `identifier` (from `audio_tts`, `images_generate`, `video_generate`). Then call `creations_show`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

imageUrl.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier`. Required without `videoUrl`; mutually exclusive with it.

mode.description: Omit for auto: image → omnihuman, video → lipsync-2.0. Pass the slug, never the display name.

resolution.description: Only for veed modes; defaults to 720p.

videoUrl.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier`. Required without `imageUrl`; mutually exclusive with it.

voiceId.description: Voice ID from `audio_voices_list`; links the voice to the creation.
